environment: Local repository-native Stage 10 Cycle Review publication-integrity preparation
constraints: no mutation of frozen source evidence

selected.tool: manual evidence minimization + repository-native sanitized derivative
selected.role: Produce one minimal claim-bounded derivative without mutating frozen source evidence

alternatives.role: Complementary secret scan before a later publication gate
alternatives.disposition: not selected for current private_ready materialization

rationale: The task requires evidence minimization, claim integrity and human publication authority boundaries.
A single repository-native derivative reduces disclosure surface compared with publishing frozen source evidence wholesale.
The current authorized gate is private_ready materialization only.
A secret scanner can complement later publication review but cannot replace manual sensitivity, claim, metadata and authorization review.
risks: A contextual fit score is heuristic and not empirical tool-performance evidence.
No scanner result exists for the current derivative.
Absence of obvious sensitive content does not establish absence of all disclosure risk.
human_controls: human review required before public-safe classification
explicit human publication authorization required before any external publication
claims must remain bounded to frozen evidence
confidential career content must remain excluded
future product direction and ClinicFlow planning remain excluded
official_sources: No external tool documentation required for the selected repository-native manual minimization path.
